title: Mirror of Electric Memories
description: A woman in a flowing golden gown stands in an ornate, flooded room holding two film reels connected by a ribbon. She faces a large oval mirror reflecting multiple versions of herself with shocked expressions as green lightning strikes from the stormy sky through the mirror.
prompt: A woman in a flowing golden-brown gown stands in an opulent baroque room filled with shallow water, holding two vintage film reels connected by a ribbon. She faces a large ornate oval mirror that reflects multiple versions of herself with horrified expressions. Bright green lightning strikes from a stormy night sky outside an arched window, arcing into the mirror. Scattered papers and film strips lie on the wet tiled floor, dramatic cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere.
